items.question: How many calendar days must a consumer wait after raising a complaint with a financial institution or insurance company before raising it with Sanadak, the Central Bank of the UAE's complaints unit?
items.fact: Sanadak requires 15 calendar days waiting after LFI complaint

items.question: Does Sanadak, the Central Bank of the UAE's unit for complaints against financial institutions and insurance companies, charge consumers a fee to resolve complaints?
items.gold: No, it is free of charge.
items.fact: Sanadak resolves complaints free of charge for consumers
